name: Bird (scooter sharing)
title: Was Bird too early? No: Lime made it work
question: Was Bird too early for scooter sharing?
answer: Bird grew faster than almost any startup in 2018 and filed for bankruptcy in December 2023. Its rival Lime ran the same dockless scooters in the same cities and reported a profitable year in 2023. Same product, same cities, same years: the difference was execution and cost, not timing.
verdict_reason: Lime ran the same model in the same years and reached profitability.

constraint.name: Nothing was missing
constraint.detail: The enablers it needed already existed; something else killed it.
